text:
Maya Chen: quick question — we're onboarding a hardware SI + cloud listing and partner asked if there's a lightweight "satellite" assessment path instead of full evidence dump. can partnerships/security agree on a minimal artifact set + upload flow? need to give partner guidance by EOD Fri :calendar: 
Samir Patel: +1. from partner ops perspective minimal useful set = SOC2 cover/attestation (redacted allowed), pen-test exec summary (not whole report), network diagram, 3rd-party deps list, contact person. presigned upload preferred. 
Priya Rao: security note — we can accept a triage bundle but with constraints: 1) SOC2 cover page + attestation statement (we'll ask for full report later if red flags) 2) pen-test executive summary + remediation status 3) artifact manifest (see sample below) 4) presign TTL max 7d and server-side encryption required. no raw credentials.
Jordan Klein: agree with Priya. SLA: security triage = 3 business days from upload. if bundle contains critical vuln indicators we escalate immediately. @Maya Chen please ensure partner includes remediation status for any findings. :rotating_light:
Li Wei: for HW/SI please include device/firmware manifest if applicable (firmware version, signing attestation). if cloud-only partner, ignore firmware. naming conv recommended: `<partner>-<artifact>-YYYYMMDD.pdf/png` so automation can pick up.
Maya Chen: thanks — can someone draft the artifact manifest template? short example below — will send to partner once we have presign automation.
Samir Patel: i'll own the manifest + presign automation. i'll add a tiny automation in the partnerships repo under `automation/marketplace-onboarding`. will produce presign links and TTL enforcement.
Maya Chen: example manifest (tiny):
```json
{
  "partner": "ACME SI",
  "submission_date": "2026-03-23",
  "artifacts": ["soc2-cover.pdf","pen-summary.pdf","network-diagram.png","firmware-manifest.json"],
  "owner": "acme-security@company.com"
}
```
Upload Bot: presign helper created a temp bucket path for manual uploads: `s3://redwood-marketplace-incoming/partners/3923456789-acme/` presigns will be 7d TTL, SSE-AES256 required. docs: https://internal.redwood/marketplace/onboarding (internal).
Priya Rao: assigning security reviewer: Jordan Klein. Jordan please confirm review SLA (3bd) and whether you need a different artifact set for HW.
Jordan Klein: confirmed 3bd SLA. for HW i will want firmware attestation + device manifest as Li suggested. otherwise the triage bundle works.
Maya Chen: timeline & owners so we have clarity: Samir -> manifest + presign automation (due Tue), Partner -> upload triage bundle (due Thu), Jordan -> triage review (3bd after upload). i'll send partner-facing doc after Samir's automation is live. thanks all :raised_hands:
